# BCGov Crow - v0.9.0

## Release type

Minor release adding guided Raven and codebase-memory-mcp setup and maintenance.

## Summary

This release adds the Crow Raven Setup Agent and supporting skill. Users can
choose the Raven MCP servers they need, review an immutable installation plan,
configure an exact codebase-memory-mcp version, and receive rate-limited update
notifications without unattended upgrades.

## Highlights

- Guided selection of Raven capability groups and individual MCP servers,
  including access and authentication metadata.
- SHA-256-bound setup plans that resolve Raven to an immutable revision before
  the user confirms installation.
- Isolated, integrity-checked codebase-memory-mcp installation and explicit
  Node.js launch paths.
- Startup smoke checks for selected servers and a Crow-owned MCP configuration
  fragment that does not overwrite unrelated client configuration.
- Invocation-time freshness checks at most once every 24 hours, explicit
  updates, retained rollback state, and no unattended upgrades.
- Raven release guidance recommending signed, provenance-backed runtime bundles
  while retaining pinned source builds as a transitional delivery path.

## Changes

- Added the Crow Raven Setup Agent, `crow-raven-setup` skill, routed foundation
  and delivery modules, and a reviewed Raven server catalog.
- Added deterministic plan, setup, status, freshness-check, and rollback
  commands with focused Node.js tests.
- Added user-local state reconciliation, npm integrity validation, catalog
  snapshots, and branch-aware versus pinned freshness tracking.
- Updated package and plugin discovery metadata and README setup guidance.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: passed.
- Archive inspection: passed; all Raven setup assets are included and local
  state, build output, and creation evidence are excluded.
- Additional checks: repository PowerShell suites, security issue conversion,
  Raven setup tests, release guards, and the SonarQube quality gate passed.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.9.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.9.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
